How do I even simplify a radical like that?

To simplify a radical, look for the largest perfect square (such as 4, 9, 16, 25, etc.) that is a factor of the number under the square root. If you find one, you can rewrite the number as a product of that square and another factor, then take the square root of the perfect square and move it outside the radical symbol.
